boundary: This contract verifies curriculum structure and learner evidence records. It does not certify expertise, scientific correctness of every claim, safe hardware operation, or real-world performance.

levels.title: Reproducible beginner
levels.exit: Run, inspect, modify, and reproduce a small experiment.
levels.exit_zh: 能够运行、检查、修改并复现一个小型实验。

levels.title: Mathematical practitioner
levels.title_zh: 数学与空间推理实践者
levels.exit: Derive and numerically verify the geometry and optimization used by a robot system.
levels.exit_zh: 能够推导并数值验证机器人系统使用的几何与优化。

levels.title: Robot-loop engineer
levels.exit: Connect sensing, state, control, simulation, safety, and diagnosis in a bounded loop.
levels.exit_zh: 能够在有边界闭环中连接感知、状态、控制、仿真、安全与诊断。

levels.title: Robot-learning engineer
levels.exit: Build data, policy, world-model, planning, and evaluation baselines without leakage.
levels.exit_zh: 能够构建无泄漏的数据、策略、世界模型、规划与评估基线。

levels.title: Embodied-system specialist
levels.exit: Own one task family end to end, including recovery and stage-resolved failures.
levels.exit_zh: 能够端到端负责一类任务，包括恢复行为和分阶段失败分析。

levels.title: Evidence-led expert
levels.exit: Reproduce a baseline, test an original hypothesis, survive independent review, and make a bounded promotion decision.
levels.exit_zh: 能够复现基线、检验原创假设、通过独立评审，并作出有边界的晋级决定。

modules.title: Tools, Python, and experiment identity
modules.artifact: A reproducible command, environment receipt, tensor-shape trace, and deliberately failing test repaired by the learner.
modules.artifact_zh: 可复现命令、环境回执、张量形状追踪，以及一项由学习者修复的故意失败测试。
modules.gate: A reviewer can rerun the command from a clean environment without guessing a parameter.
modules.gate_zh: 评审者能够在干净环境中复现命令，不需要猜测任何参数。

modules.title: Linear algebra, probability, optimization, and numerics
modules.title_zh: 线性代数、概率、优化与数值方法
modules.artifact: A derivation and numerical notebook that includes units, residuals, conditioning, uncertainty, and one pathological case.
modules.artifact_zh: 一份包含单位、残差、条件数、不确定性和一个病态案例的推导与数值 Notebook。
modules.gate: Analytic and numerical checks agree within a declared tolerance, and the failure case is explained.
modules.gate_zh: 解析与数值检查在声明容差内一致，并能解释失败案例。

modules.title: Frames, rotations, and SE(3)
modules.artifact: A frame graph and executable transform-chain check with a rotation singularity or discontinuity test.
modules.artifact_zh: 坐标系图、可执行变换链检查，以及旋转奇异性或不连续性测试。
modules.gate: Every vector has a frame, unit, shape, and composition direction; inverse and round-trip checks pass.
modules.gate_zh: 每个向量都声明坐标系、单位、形状与复合方向；逆变换和往返检查通过。

modules.title: Kinematics, dynamics, contact, actuation, and control
modules.title_zh: 运动学、动力学、接触、驱动与控制
modules.artifact: A bounded closed-loop controller with rate, saturation, watchdog, stop path, contact trace, and injected-fault report.
modules.artifact_zh: 带频率、饱和、看门狗、停止路径、接触轨迹和故障注入报告的有界闭环控制器。
modules.gate: Nominal and fault cases are repeatable; unsafe or stale commands are rejected rather than silently clipped.
modules.gate_zh: 正常与故障案例均可复现；不安全或过期命令会被拒绝，而不是静默裁剪。

modules.title: Sensors, estimation, and simulation
modules.title_zh: 传感器、状态估计与仿真
modules.artifact: A composed simulator scene and time-aligned state stream with calibration, uncertainty, contact, reset, and observability checks.
modules.artifact_zh: 一个组合式仿真场景与时间对齐状态流，包含标定、不确定性、接触、复位和可观测性检查。
modules.gate: The report separates sensing, calibration, estimation, model, and controller errors using logged evidence.
modules.gate_zh: 报告使用日志证据区分传感、标定、估计、模型与控制器误差。

modules.title: Task protocols and trustworthy datasets
modules.title_zh: 任务协议与可信数据集
modules.artifact: A versioned dataset card, episode schema, integrity report, leakage audit, and declared OOD split.
modules.artifact_zh: 版本化数据卡、Episode Schema、完整性报告、泄漏审计和声明过的 OOD 划分。
modules.gate: Dataset identity and train/validation/test boundaries are machine-checkable; leakage and coverage failures are retained.
modules.gate_zh: 数据身份和训练/验证/测试边界可机器检查；泄漏与覆盖失败被保留。

modules.title: Learning foundations and imitation
modules.artifact: A from-scratch learning baseline with tiny-set overfit, held-out evaluation, action contract, learning curves, and failure examples.
modules.artifact_zh: 一个从头训练的学习基线，包含极小集过拟合、保留集评估、动作契约、学习曲线和失败样例。
modules.gate: The learner can explain optimization behavior and distinguish offline prediction quality from closed-loop task quality.
modules.gate_zh: 学习者能够解释优化行为，并区分离线预测质量与闭环任务质量。

modules.title: VLA, reinforcement learning, and planning
modules.artifact: Matched policy baselines plus closed-loop evaluation, language/vision ablations, latency measurement, and a reward or planner audit.
modules.artifact_zh: 匹配预算的策略基线，以及闭环评估、语言/视觉消融、延迟测量和奖励或规划器审计。
modules.gate: Language, vision, and learning claims survive counterfactual ablations under the same data and execution budget.
modules.gate_zh: 语言、视觉与学习结论在相同数据和执行预算下通过反事实消融。

modules.title: World models and action-conditioned prediction
modules.title_zh: 世界模型与动作条件预测
modules.artifact: A one-step model, horizon-resolved rollout report, MPC baseline, action-swap ablation, and closed-loop utility comparison.
modules.artifact_zh: 单步模型、按 Horizon 分解的 Rollout 报告、MPC 基线、动作交换消融和闭环效用对比。
modules.gate: Prediction error is separated from planning utility; the world model changes executed action and improves a declared task metric.
modules.gate_zh: 预测误差与规划效用被分开；世界模型确实改变执行动作，并改善声明过的任务指标。

modules.title: Cross-embodiment systems, task planning, and recovery
modules.title_zh: 跨本体系统、任务规划与恢复
modules.artifact: A typed observation/action adapter, task-and-motion plan, monitored execution trace, and recovery or safe-stop case.
modules.artifact_zh: 类型化观测/动作适配器、任务与运动计划、受监控执行轨迹，以及恢复或安全停止案例。
modules.gate: Embodiment identity, unsupported actions, planner failures, and recovery decisions are explicit and testable.
modules.gate_zh: 本体身份、不支持动作、规划失败与恢复决策均明确且可测试。

modules.title: Own one task family end to end
modules.artifact: One complete task system with success contract, stage-resolved metrics, perturbations, recovery behavior, and negative results.
modules.artifact_zh: 一套完整任务系统，包含成功契约、分阶段指标、扰动、恢复行为与负结果。
modules.gate: A reviewer can attribute failures to a stage and reproduce both a success and a representative failure.
modules.gate_zh: 评审者能够把失败定位到具体阶段，并复现一个成功案例和一个代表性失败。

modules.title: Generalization, research evidence, and deployment decisions
modules.title_zh: 泛化、科研证据与部署决策
modules.artifact: A frozen protocol, independently reproduced baseline, multi-seed uncertainty, OOD matrix, ablations, risk register, and promotion or stop decision.
modules.artifact_zh: 冻结协议、独立复现基线、多随机种子不确定性、OOD 矩阵、消融、风险登记和晋级或停止决定。
modules.gate: An independent reviewer can trace every major claim to raw evidence and accepts the bounded conclusion; hardware remains a separate authorized gate.
modules.gate_zh: 独立评审者能够把每项主要结论追溯到原始证据并接受有边界结论；真机仍是单独授权门禁。

goals.title: VLA and WAM researcher
goals.title_zh: VLA 与 WAM 研究者

goals.title: Dexterity and teleoperation specialist
goals.title_zh: 灵巧操作与遥操作专家
